Board v2 rules

  1. Start at either Develop Project Charter. Each turn move one process square, along the direction of an arrow. If multiple arrows leave a space you may choose; never move backward against a printed arrow or return to a square already used on that run.
  2. Green process square: attempt a definition card; a correct match earns 2 points.
  3. Olive circle on a path: collect and read a concept card for 1 point (in optional Quiz Challenge mode the answer must be correct).
  4. Purple triangle on a path: roll a die; an even result gives a concept card. Yellow Performed Early or Repeats Multiple band on a square: roll a die; an odd result gives a concept card. If both yellow bands appear, roll once.
  5. Blue-hub jump at a dead end: Planning → All Planning Processes, Monitoring & Controlling → All M&C Processes, Executing → Risk Coordination. You go to that exact blue rectangle, never the nearest available square. Follow the printed outgoing arrow afterward; if there is no usable route return to your charter.
  6. Bold repeated processes with the same number allow a same-turn jump to another copy of that process. A process cannot be reused on the same run; previous card answers remain used throughout the game.
  7. Reach the red Close Project or Phase with at least 30 points to win. With fewer than 30 points, the board sends you to Project Document Updates instead. Points remain when you restart at the charter.
